• Scientific name: Ictalurus ochoterenai (de Buen, 1946)
  • Common name: Chapala Catfish
  • Type locality: Lago de Chapala, Isla Patos, Mexico.
  • Synonym: Haustor ochoterenai
  • IUCN Red List category: Not Evaluated
Central America: endemic to the Lerma River basin, Mexico.
Breeding: unreported. There is no breeding report.

Etymology: Ictalurus comes from the Greek ichthys, meaning fish, and ailouros, meaning cat; literally "fish cat" (catfish). The species is named to honour Isaac Ochoterena, who founded the Institute of Biology at the National Autonomous University of México.
Anales del Instituto de Biologia de la Universidad de Mexico v. 17 (nos 1-2), pp 271, Fig. 1.
